newsitem.title: ITALY: UBS starts Parmalat 10-year bond placement.
newsitem.headline: UBS starts Parmalat 10-year bond placement.

text.p: Swiss banking group UBS has started direct private placement of a 10-year 200 billion lire bond being launched by Italy's largest quoted food group Parmalat Finanziaria, a statement said.
The bond will be launched on January 2, 1997, with coupons annually deferred from January 2, 1998 to January 2, 2002. From January 2, 2002 coupons can be annual or half yearly.
The gross rate is 7.25 percent. Five years from issue the rate can be changed from fixed to variable, at the simple gross yield on six month short term Italian bills (Bots) plus 0.70 percent.
